[stdout]
Sign out one of your other devices. Its shares stop, and it has to sign in
again before it can share. To sign out this device, use 'purlview logout'.

When two devices have the same name, give the id this command then shows.

Usage:
  purlview devices signout <name> [flags]

Examples:
  purlview devices signout laptop
  purlview devices signout laptop --yes

Flags:
  -h, --help   Show help for signout.
      --yes    Sign out without asking.
[stderr]
